newsitem.title: USA: Servico hires Smith to explore REIT options.
newsitem.headline: Servico hires Smith to explore REIT options.

text.p: Servico Inc said Wednesday that it hired Smith Barney to explore opportunities from real estate investment trust structures.
The national hotel owner and operator said because of increasing interest in hotel REITS, it is exploring the area "as a possible new direction."
"We at this point are exploring what is a very large universe of potential opportunities," company Vice-President of Finance Warren Knight said.
Knight said options include making "Servico into a REIT," but he emphasized that such an option is one of many and not necessarily one the company is focusing on.
